recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-contrast composite featuring a central smiling female figure in casual American-themed attire, flanked by two symmetrical British Royal Guards in red tunics, set against a clear blue sky. The composition uses a bold, multi-colored sans-serif title at the bottom with a thick white outline.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry of the guards framing the central subject
Contrast between the red military uniforms and the white casual tank top
Juxtaposition of American flag iconography with British ceremonial dress
Text overlapping the subject's waist to create depth
coreInvariants: Bright, even studio lighting with minimal shadows
Vibrant primary color palette (Red, White, Blue)
Subject making a peace sign gesture
Clear blue sky background with soft white clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female figure, medium shot from waist up, slightly larger scale than the background guards.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face and the large, outlined title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the American flag shirt, then to the large title, and finally out to the symmetrical guards.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the frame is densely packed with figures, though the sky provides breathing room at the top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Scarlet Red (Guards' tunics and title accents)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright White (Subject's shirt, belts, and title outline)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Royal Blue (Subject's jeans and title accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value across all elements to convey an upbeat, energetic mood.
paletteRestrictions: Strict adherence to patriotic red, white, and blue

letterConstructionRules: Rounded corners on the outer white stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters used for the main title to appear approachable and youthful
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif paired with a light, clean metadata sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Thick white sticker-like outline around text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the main title.
Offers a similar early-2000s commercial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A bright studio photo of a smiling teenage girl with long brown hair wearing a white tank top with an American flag print, making a peace sign. She is flanked by two British Royal Guards in red uniforms and bearskin hats, cropped at the shoulders. The background is a clear blue sky with soft clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large lowercase title at the bottom center using a bold condensed sans-serif. Alternate the fill color of the letters between royal blue and red. Apply a thick white outer stroke to the entire word block to create a sticker effect. Add a small subtitle in thin white sans-serif at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a thick white outline?
Are there two symmetrical guards in red?
Is the lighting bright and commercial?

adjustableVariables: Specific flag motif on the shirt
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the peace sign is clearly visible.
Check that the guards are symmetrical and cropped similarly.
Verify the text outline does not obscure the letter forms.
Confirm the color palette is strictly red, white, and blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central youthful subject + Symmetrical uniformed background figures + Bold outlined lowercase sans-serif title + Patriotic color palette = Early 2000s Teen Comedy Aesthetic.
